build_fastapi_static_router: build a FastAPI router that serves static files like index.html and logo.png
create_read_root_endpoint: create an async endpoint that returns index.html as a FileResponse at the root path
create_get_logo_endpoint: create an async endpoint that returns logo.png as a FileResponse at the /logo.png path
review_static_router: review the FastAPI router and its two static file serving endpoints
refactor_static_file_paths: refactor the static file paths to use configurable directory variables instead of hardcoded strings
